name: Nitzan Tzur-Ilan
title: Senior Research Economist
bio_long: I am a Research Economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas. My research lies at the intersection of real estate finance, urban economics, and environmental economics. I study how local shocks — from credit market policy to large infrastructure investments — affect housing prices, rents, migration, and consumer spending. My ongoing work examines the local effects of data center openings on residential real estate markets. I use quasi-experimental methods, including event studies and difference-in-differences designs, applied to large administrative and transaction-level datasets.
